skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recall the characteristics of land, functions, and methods of state management of land.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding basis of state management of land
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basis of state management of land.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding organizational structure of state management of land
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the organizational structure, decentralization, and division of powers within the state management machinery of land.
Understand the contents of some land management policies.
Apply knowledge on land policies to explain certain situations in land management and use.
Analyze situations and policies to make decisions.
Be able to work individually and in teams when choosing policies and solving land management issues.
Be proactive in learning, research, and group work.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Selecting appropriate methods and materials for analysis
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Be proactive in selecting appropriate methods and materials for analyzing real-world land management situations.
Be proactive in presenting research topics.

prerequisite_courses: Research Methods in Economics and Society
